note: The sink fields are semantic views over the exact vulnerable call expression `this+coverage`: `coverage_ptr` is the address of that font-backed Coverage object and `coverage_copy_end` is the end address of a full `Coverage` by-value copy span starting from it. `iter_ctor.uses_reference_ctor` is the source-level constructor-kind view for the vulnerable one-argument `hb_auto_t (T1 t1)` root-cause declaration.
